basics.name: Thomas Ingram
basics.label: Full-Stack Web Developer; Problem Solver; Collaborator; Mentor
basics.summary: Senior full-stack developer with 15+ years building and architecting web applications, roughly split between frontend and backend work - from database design and SQL to CSS and polished frontend interfaces. Deep experience with React and TypeScript, having built and maintained design systems used across enterprise products, with additional backend experience in Ruby and C#, and integrating REST and GraphQL APIs. Track record of leading architecture decisions and mentoring junior developers, equally effective owning projects independently or driving them within highly collaborative, cross-functional teams.

work.name: CISYS LifeSciences
work.summary: Configured, built, and maintained websites and web applications for clients, advocating for test-driven development and other engineering best practices.

work.name: RoleModel Software
work.summary: Delivered custom web applications for clients across a range of industries and supported the growth of junior developers.
highlights: Built applications including a media-distribution kiosk, accident-report downloader, and weather forecasting tool.
Contributed to several large healthcare-related applications.
Mentored junior developers through one-on-one coaching.

work.name: Gather Digital
work.summary: Developed product features, platform capabilities, and third-party integrations for mobile and web applications.
highlights: Streamlined many integrations with third-party REST and SOAP APIs.
Added contact sharing to a native Android application.
Enhanced a custom CMS and API platform.
Built internal tooling for submitting apps to the Apple App Store and Google Play.
Built custom photo wall powered by specific Instagram keywords.

work.name: NetApp
work.summary: Helped develop a tool enabling sales teams to configure large enterprise server rooms for clients, collaborating with an international team of developers.
highlights: Built a React presentation library shared across the team
Mentored junior developers on the team

work.name: Rivers Agency
work.summary: Led technical delivery across client platforms, APIs, frontend systems, and developer practices.
highlights: Led Git training for the development team.
Built a distributed clinical management system for a local university, including a custom OAuth2 provider for SSO.
Architected and implemented a custom frontend powered by GraphQL and React.
Managed and developed REST and GraphQL APIs, data-driven static sites, and a component library.
Maintained, tested, and improved multiple Magento sites.
Mentored junior developers.

work.name: Lana
work.summary: Developed frontend capabilities for a financial product serving unbanked and underbanked customers.
highlights: Designed and implemented new modular frontend architecture.
Built the first third-party payment integration for pawn-loan extensions.
Delivered customer-facing tools that expanded financial-management flexibility.

work.name: EZCORP
work.summary: Led frontend architecture and feature development for a pawn-loan management platform, partnering closely with backend and design teams.
highlights: Built and evolved two design systems using React, TypeScript, and Storybook.
Architected a new frontend architecture for the pawn-loan management system.
Integrated REST APIs endpoints across customer-facing features.
Created a configurable promotions platform supporting giveaways and interactive experiences.
Adopted AI-first development practices toward the end of the engagement.

education.details: Spent significant time learning programming languages, frameworks and tools through online courses, tutorials and personal projects. Built a portfolio of web applications and contributed to open-source projects.
Earned a certificate in MySQL Database Design, gaining knowledge in database architecture, normalization and query optimization.
